name: Lemon Haze
summary: Lemon Haze is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] commonly described as a cross of [[lemon-skunk|Lemon Skunk]] and [[silver-haze|Silver Haze]]. Its breeder and release year are not documented, and the name is used by several unrelated seed lines. It is often confused with [[super-lemon-haze|Super Lemon Haze]], whose Haze parent is Super Silver Haze rather than Silver Haze.

sources.title: Lemon Haze
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms Lemon Skunk x Silver Haze as the commonly cited cross.
